description: Get what's new at SlickFast from the live News page (https://slickfast.com/news). Returns a short summary, the page URL, and a link to the page's JSON source (the exact spec behind it, useful for learning how SlickFast specs work). Pass archive:true to list all past news posts (number, title, date, URL). Use when the user asks what's new, for a changelog or for past updates, or when the "SlickFast News" prompt is used. No key needed. Always fetched live. Summarize the facts and give the URL; do not paste the page's HTML.

archive.description: true = list all News drops from https://slickfast.com/news/archive.json. Omit or false = current drop only.

name: news
title: SlickFast News — what's shipping
